origin.description: Eager pipe variant, meant to be assigned to an infix symbol.

arguments.name: lhs
arguments.text: A value, or the dot placeholder.

arguments.name: rhs
arguments.text: A function or a call, using the same placement rules as %>%.

origin.details: The same function as %!>%. Each step is evaluated immediately in the calling environment, and the dot is updated as the chain proceeds. Side effects run from the first step forward.
origin.value: The result of the chain, or a function when the left-hand side is the dot.

translation.description: Eager pipe. The same function as eager.

arguments.name: lhs
arguments.text: The starting value, or DOT to return a functional sequence.

arguments.name: steps
arguments.text: The same callable and (function, args, kwargs) steps as pipe.

translation.details: pipe_eager_lexical and eager are one function. Each step runs as soon as the previous step returns, so a chain that prints and then returns its argument prints forward.
translation.value: The piped value, or an FSeq when lhs is DOT.
translation.example:
from magrittr.pipe import pipe_eager_lexical
pipe_eager_lexical(list(range(1, 11)), sum)
